facts.text: Ankeny was founded as an agrarian community on April 22, 1875, by John Fletcher Ankeny and his wife Sarah on 80 acres purchased July 11, 1874.
A narrow‑gauge railroad ran through Ankeny in 1874, connecting Des Moines to Ames, and was later converted to wide gauge by the Chicago‑Northwestern in 1879.
In 1947, Deere & Company bought the local factory, turning it into the John Deere Des Moines Works that still produces agricultural equipment today.
The new Kirkendall Public Library opened in 2020, offering 55,000 square feet of space, a jump from the 26,000‑square‑foot old library.
Ankeny hosts 60 parks covering over 800 acres, including two aquatic centers, a dog park, and a disc golf course that attracts regional players.
Ankeny was incorporated on February 28, 1903, as a single square mile town.
